Definition: Nachash, the name of two persons apparently non-Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Nahash = "serpent"; n pr m; 1) a king of the Ammonites during the time of king Saul; 2) the father of Abigail, the mother of Amasa, the commander of Absalom's army
